Subject: PayrollSoft procurement intake — DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list & PO routing

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the product demo last week. We're starting vendor intake so Procurement and Legal have a clear checklist for activation. Can you please share the following so we can move to PO and go-live?

- Signed DPA or your standard DPA template (we prefer DocuSign envelope if you have one).
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy or a portal link to the hosted report).
- Current subprocessor list (CSV or spreadsheet) including country of processing and whether any subprocessors store production data.
- Billing & remit instructions (billing contact, invoice email, tax ID) and whether you accept PO with Net30 terms.

If you have a preferred PO reference format, please include that as well; Procurement will create the PO once we have remit and billing details.

Goal: get docs and a DocuSign link today so Procurement can route the DPA and create the PO by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer

If Procurement needs any additional attestations or a completed security questionnaire (we often fill out a short RCA or custom security form), let me know and I’ll loop in our security lead.

Best,

Thanks for the forward — I reviewed the packet. A few quick items:

- PO routing: Procurement will issue a PO in NetSuite. Please ask Elena to include the exact remit address and Tax ID on the invoice; billing@payrollsoft.com is the invoice recipient. Our preferred PO number format is P-YYYY-#### (we'll assign once we create it).
- DPA: Laura — we will run a quick redline. I anticipate one minor edit to the data retention clause (90 days -> 45 days for non-critical logs). Laura, can you confirm?
- Subprocessor list: CSV looks complete; security wants a confirmation that none of the subprocessors are outside EU/US for production storage. Elena — can you confirm data-at-rest locations for the listed subprocessors?

Plan: once DPA redlines are approved (target today), we'll countersign via DocuSign and create the PO (Net30). Please confirm if PayrollSoft needs a purchase order number on the DocuSign envelope prior to countersignature — otherwise we'll add the PO number to the invoice.

Attaching our PO instructions template: redwood_po_template.pdf
